subject: Connecting to MySql with SSH tunneling

messages.author: 9f1d9e735e31b5ee
messages.subject: Connecting to MySql with SSH tunneling
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to connect to a remote MySql databse through SSH tunneling. I could succesfully connect to DB 

1. by using "username" and "password". 
2. by using username and local private key
3. by using username, local private key and key phrase.

I am facing an issue when I am trying to do ssh tunnelling with username and private key which is on remote machine.(say for example private key file present on ftp or s3 etc.) Is there a way to do ssh tunnelling with remote private key?

Please help me with your suggestions.

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Connecting to MySql with SSH tunneling
parts: You would need to include the private key in the directory of your Shiny application so that it is uploaded to shinyapps.io and then call out to the system to run ssh in the background when your application starts.
